# Hackera

> Hackera is a digital agency from Bulgaria offering 250+ digital services in 20 categories in one place: web development, SEO, design, marketing, e-commerce, AI automation, cybersecurity, GDPR compliance and more. Transparent pricing, one contact for everything.

**Who it is for:** small and medium businesses in Bulgaria that want a professional digital presence (website, online store, marketing) without hiring a separate contractor for every task.

**Main package:** "Website as a Service" - from 15 EUR/month, 12-month contract. Includes a company website of up to 5 pages, logo, copywriting, hosting, domain, SSL, GDPR documents and monthly technical support.

**Company:** Imoti 98 EOOD, company ID (EIK) 207210213. ul. 340 No. 3, Sofia, Bulgaria. Phone: +359 87 901 8593.
